notes: Delete mirroring finance-replace-0004: removes 'The IMF is headquartered in Washington, D.C.', the revision's original fact, a stored fact on a functional relation (headquartered_in). Cardinality question: another candidate city, Geneva (the revision's new value), 'no' before because an organisation has one main headquarters; after the removal the reason for 'no' is gone, so 'does not know'. The IMF has no tie to Geneva, so no separate 'no' is stored. Related near uses the inverse (headquartered_in is tagged inverse:headquarters_of), asked from the city's side. The edit names the organisation by its abbreviation, so related far asks it under the full name (binding, the README's own example); both answers are stored. Derived: two compositions through the removed fact: the river of the headquarters city (the Potomac, a fact stored about Washington, D.C. by name) and whether the IMF shares a city with the World Bank. The revision's language question ('English') was dropped: English is the IMF's working language, so a model could answer it without the city. Unrelated near asks the seat of another international body, the International Court of Justice, because the World Bank now appears in a derived question. Counts for the revision's own phrases are copied from finance-replace-0004; new phrases are in count_requests.
